Build's clean now, exit code 0.

The real bug: `src/core/settings.js:17` had `maxRetries: retries` — referencing an undefined bare variable instead of `env.retries`, throwing a `ReferenceError` that aborted the link stage every time. Fixed it to `env.retries`, and the build now finishes with `dist/bundle.js` emitted, 3 warnings (the deprecated-API, unused-export, and circular-import notices — all pre-existing and non-fatal), 0 errors.
